title: Process
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
If you disconnect a business partner because he/she has reached the disconnection dunning level, the system changes the
creditworthiness of the business partner for each disconnection. To do this, go to Customizing under |}SAP Utilities 5 Customer
Service » Process Execution » Disconnection/Reconnection Define Processing Variants for Disconnection Documents 4 and

make an entry in the Creditworthiness Weighting field. The change is reversed if the disconnection that triggered it is canceled.

Process

The flow of the business process is not set by the system, but is rather controlled by workflows. There are two main workflows with
corresponding sub-workflows. They are as follows:

e Main Workflow for Disconnection/Reconnection/Collection (ISUDISCON12)
e Create Disconnection Order Workflow (ISUDISC12)

e Confirm Disconnection Order Workflow (ISUDISCREP12)

e Reverse Disconnection Workflow (ISUDISCSTORN)

e Interrupt Disonnection Workflow (ISUDISCBREAK)

e Terminate Workflow with Follow-Up (ISUDISCSHUT1)

e Create Reconnection Order Workflow (ISUREC12)

e Confirm Reconnection Order Workflow (ISURECREP12)

e Main Workflow for Disconnection at Customer Request (ISUDISCON12)

Main Workflow for Disconnection/Reconnection/Collection
